description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Freudenberg Performance Materials is part of the Freudenberg Group and a leading global supplier of innovative technical textiles for a broad range of markets: From apparel, automotive, building materials, civil engineering, energy, filter media, healthcare and to building interiors and more. Join our team and shape the future of innovation with us! Discover our world at www.freudenberg-pm.com.

You support our team as IT Financial Controller

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for IT cost controlling, IT Service allocation and IT Service charging (IT service catalogue);
  • Support budget planning, forecasting and project controlling across IT;
  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting related to IT services, projects, and operations;
  • Support internal cross charging and cost allocation processes;
  • Maintain data quality and consistency for controlling‑relevant financial and organizational data;
  • Contribute to the improvement of IT cost controlling methodologies, analysis, and reporting (KPI creation);
  • Development of internal contracts and financial frameworks (e.g., Service Level Agreements);
  • Creation of annual and medium‑term plans and management reporting;
  • Provide transparency and advisory support on IT costs and financial structures;
  • Perform budget vs. actual analyses for IT‑Project‑Management, IT‑Operations, and IT‑Support;
  • Monitor compliance with financial standards, processes, and controlling guidelines;
  • Coordinate and monitor defined corrective and improvement measures.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Business Informatics, Business Administration or equivalent combination of education and experience;
  • > 3 years professional experience;
  • Proven experiences in cost analysis / controlling;
  • Professional in Financial planning processes;
  • Experience working on projects represents an advantage;
  • Previous experience in a multinational and/or manufacturing environment is considered a plus;
  • Advanced English language skills; German would be an advantage;
  • SAP S4 knowledge (FI/CO, MM, PS);
  • Advanced Excel skills.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
